sources.label: Avalanche C-Chain public RPC latest-state reads

reserveReview.rationale: Fresh latest-state reads on 2026-08-20 enumerated every collateral address from the Ethereum, HyperEVM, Base, and Avalanche Parallelizer diamonds, then read each token balance and the diamond's getOracleValues() price. The valued holdings were $138.479170 frxUSD, $808,881.779410 sfrxUSD, $17,184.826813 USDe, $791,161.330663 sUSDe, $253,862.575542 sUSDS, $21.260356 USDS, $557.809733 direct USDC, and $260,402.616831 ygamiUSDC (total $2,132,210.678518). The two USDe and sUSDe branches are aggregated under their reviewed names; direct USDC is aggregated across Base and Avalanche; ygamiUSDC remains separately labeled and risk-rated while its reviewed ERC-4626 underlying is Circle USDC.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current on-chain ERC-20 balances held by all four live Parallelizer USDp diamonds, valued with each diamond's getOracleValues() price and normalized to the summed reserve value
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified reserve assets were returned by the four on-chain collateral lists; any future collateral address without a curated descriptor is emitted as an explicitly unlinked slice and fails the next full-composition review until re-curated.
